denied.title: Restricted access
denied.hint: Staff management is reserved for salon accounts. Ask your administrator for access.
denied.scheduleHint: Staff working hours are reserved for salon accounts. Ask your administrator for access.

toolbar.restricted: Creating practitioner records and inviting accounts are reserved for the manager and administrator ranks.

practitioners.title: Practitioners — {count}
practitioners.hint: The records that carry an agenda. Open one to enter its recurring hours, its time off and the services it performs.
practitioners.emptyDescriptionManager: As long as nobody is registered, the booking journey offers no slot at all. Create a practitioner record from a staff account to make that person bookable.
practitioners.emptyDescriptionReader: As long as nobody is registered, the booking journey offers no slot at all. A manager or an administrator can create a practitioner record from a staff account.
practitioners.subtitle: Hours, time off, services

accounts.title: Accounts — {count}
accounts.hint: The identities that sign in to the back office, with their role. An account is not a practitioner record: it carries the access, not the agenda.
accounts.emptyDescriptionAdmin: Invite at least one person so the salon can be run by more than one pair of hands.
accounts.emptyDescriptionReader: A salon administrator can invite the people who will run it with you.
accounts.caption: Staff accounts of the establishment, with their role and the state of their access.
accounts.name: Name

accountActions.reactivated: Account reactivated: signing in is possible again.
accountActions.deactivated: Account deactivated. Its assignments and past appointments are untouched.
accountActions.newToken: New activation link to pass on to {email}.

invitationLink.label: Activation link
invitationLink.hint: Copy it whole: it carries the activation code, and shortening it would make it unusable.

invite.deniedBody: Inviting a staff member is reserved for the administrator rank. The staff list stays readable, and a salon administrator can issue the invitation for you. <link>Back to staff</link>.
invite.issuedBody: Pass this link on to {email}: it lets them set their password, once. It is shown here only, and a new invitation can be reissued at any time from the list.
invite.emailHint: This is the sign-in identifier, and it cannot be changed afterwards.
invite.roleHint: The role decides what the person will be able to do; it can be changed later from the list.

member.deniedBody: Creating a practitioner record is reserved for the manager rank. The staff list stays readable, and a salon manager or administrator can create the record for you. <link>Back to staff</link>.
member.hint: Attach a staff account to an agenda. Until a person has their record, no service can be assigned to them and the booking journey offers no slot.
member.createdBody: {name} now appears among the practitioners. Open the record to enter their hours, their time off and the services they perform.
member.accountHint: The account carries the back-office access; the record carries the agenda.
member.accountEmpty: No staff account to attach. A salon administrator must invite the person first.
member.accountRequired: Choose the account to make bookable.
member.displayNameHint: This is the name the client reads when choosing a practitioner.
member.bioHint: Optional — a few lines introducing this practitioner.

notFound.title: Practitioner not found
notFound.body: No record of this salon carries that identifier. It may have been created in another establishment, or deleted since.

profile.title: Practitioner record
profile.suspendedNotice: This record is suspended: no slot is offered for this practitioner, whatever the hours below say.
profile.hint: The name the client reads when choosing a practitioner, the introduction saved for them, and the state of the record. A suspended record stays listed: it only stops being offered for booking.
profile.displayNameHint: This is the name the client reads when choosing a practitioner.
profile.bioHintEmpty: Optional — a few lines introducing this practitioner. No introduction is saved for now.
profile.bioHintFilled: Optional — a few lines introducing this practitioner. The field shows the introduction saved today: correct it, or empty it to remove it.
profile.reactivated: Record reactivated: the engine offers its slots again.
profile.suspended: Record suspended: no slot will be offered any more. Its hours, its assignments and its past appointments are untouched.
profile.restricted: Correcting a record and suspending it are reserved for salon managers.

schedule.title: Weekly hours
schedule.hint: Hours written in the salon’s time zone ({timeZone}), stored in UTC. Total entered: {total} per week.
schedule.savedBody: The slots offered to clients take this week into account.
schedule.restricted: Changing the hours is reserved for the manager rank.
schedule.incomplete: Fill in both ends of the range, or remove it.
schedule.overlap: two ranges on the same day overlap
schedule.endBeforeStart: A range must end after it starts.

availability.title: Slots on offer
availability.noServiceHint: Assign an active service to see what the engine offers.
availability.hint: Next free slots for “{service}”, exactly as the booking page computes them.
availability.emptyTitle: No slot over the next seven days
availability.emptyDescription: An empty working week, a suspended record, an unassigned service or a time off covering the period all produce this result.

timeOff.title: Blocked periods and time off
timeOff.emptyTitle: No time off in this period
timeOff.emptyDescription: This practitioner’s slots follow their working week without exception. A blocked period removes them occasionally, without touching the recurring hours.
timeOff.confirm: Remove the time off of {period} ({reason})? It cannot be restored, and the practitioner will become bookable again over that period.
timeOff.restricted: Adding and removing time off are reserved for the manager rank.
timeOff.wholeDayHint: Leave empty for a whole day.
timeOff.toDateHint: Excluded bound: this is the day the practitioner comes back.
timeOff.reasonHint: Internal to the salon — never shown to clients.
timeOff.unreachable: The server did not answer. Check the connection and try again.
timeOff.missingTo: Give the day back at work.
timeOff.rangeInvalid: The day back at work must come after the first day off, and time off cannot exceed {max} days.
timeOff.invalid: The time off entered is invalid.

services.title: Services performed
services.hint: A service no practitioner performs produces no slot at all, whatever the hours entered.
services.conflict: This service is already assigned to them.
services.emptyDescription: Create at least one service before you can assign it to this practitioner.

actions.statusRequired: Say whether the account should be active.
actions.invalidTimeOff: The time off entered is invalid.
